comment: The declared estate the converge asserts. Names hold their class's grammar (naming.py): a super metric is <owner> - <bundle> - <kind> - <measure> (<unit>), and no name contains ':' or '|'. Formulas use metric keys proven on a live estate; edit one after the first converge to watch drift repair.

supermetrics.name: Converge Demo - Ops Estate - VM - Active Memory (GiB)
supermetrics.description: Converge-demo metric: actively-touched guest memory in GiB. Safe to delete; owned by the ops-estate companion harness.
